rights_note: Yelp permission request was sent; no written response had been received on 2026-09-28. The project publishes only aggregate timings and memory observations at the maintainer's direction. No input, option text, prediction, or raw review record is included.

quality_metrics.note: No auditable held-out source-split quality report is included.

limitations: One fixed development request and few repetitions do not establish general latency, throughput, or accuracy.
CPU and GPU use different weight formats and arithmetic precision; this compares deployment paths, not isolated hardware speedup.
CPU process RSS and GPU framework allocation are different memory measures.
Generated tokens per second does not apply because the model scores explicit options and emits structured decisions.
